app.title: Jota | Free music self-hosted service
app.description: Jota is a free, self-hosted music service. Stream your music anywhere, anytime.

common.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete it?

search.title: Search
search.youtubePlaceholder: Search in YouTube (videos, playlists or channels)
search.spotifyPlaceholder: Paste a Spotify {type} link, URI or ID...

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account and how Jota syncs playback.

discord.title: Discord
discord.description: Show what you're listening to in your Discord status.
discord.label: Discord rich presence

idle.title: Background memory
idle.description: Reload the app after it has been hidden for a while to free cached images. Playback is not affected.
idle.label: Idle reload

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Share the app log when reporting a problem.

playlists.title: Saved
playlists.description: Back up every playlist, Spotify and YouTube included, in a JSON file or restore them. Re-importing keeps the newer copy when a playlist already exists.
playlists.imported: Backup restored: {playlists} playlists, {follows} follows, {saved} saved, {order} orders, {settings} settings

autosave.title: Autosave
autosave.description: Save your playlists to jota.backup.json every so often, in a folder or an account like Google Drive or Dropbox.
autosave.stale: The last save could not write: the service served a cached copy of the file. Choose the location again.
autosave.importHint: Bring to your library what other devices have saved in the file too.
autosave.secret: The file carries your relay address and its token in plain text, so anyone who can open it can use them.

errors.picker: The file picker is not available
errors.read: The save file cannot be read. Choose it again.
errors.write: The save file cannot be written. Check the location and try again.
errors.version: That file was written by another version of Jota. Overwrite it to start fresh.

search.referenceOnly: Spotify only opens a {type} from a link, URI or ID. Paste one, or search by name under another type.

welcome.title: Welcome to Jota
welcome.body: Log in with Spotify to search, play and sync your music.

spotify.prompt: Connect with Spotify to use this.
spotify.thirdPartyNote: Risk: Jota uses its own third-party Spotify client, and Spotify may block the account you connect.
spotify.completeLogin: Complete Spotify login, then return here.
spotify.offline: Spotify is unreachable — showing your saved library
spotify.offlineLimited: Spotify is unreachable, and this needs a live connection. Your saved library still works.

youtube.signInBody: This track needs a signed-in YouTube account — it is age-restricted or YouTube asked to confirm you are not a bot.
youtube.signInRisk: Risk: using an account this way can get it banned by Google. Prefer a secondary account.
youtube.unavailable: In-app sign-in is not available on this platform. Paste your cookies or import a cookies.txt in Settings → Account.
youtube.errorHint: {error} — you can paste your cookies in Settings → Account instead.
youtube.settingsRisk: Signing in with a Google account and using it to play audio can get that account banned by Google. Use an account you can afford to lose, and prefer a secondary one.
youtube.loginClosed: Sign-in was closed before YouTube accepted the session.
youtube.loginTimeout: YouTube did not finish the sign-in in time.
youtube.signInWindow: Sign in in the app window
youtube.browserImportHint: Reads the YouTube session {browser} already holds on this machine. Close it first if the read fails.
youtube.cookiesManual: Paste cookies or import a cookies.txt
youtube.unavailableShort: In-app sign-in is not available on this platform. Paste your cookies or import a cookies.txt export below.
youtube.pasteHint: Import a cookies.txt exported while signed in: on a youtube.com tab use an extension (Get cookies.txt), or run copy(document.cookie) only if you do not need private playlists. The cookies that open your lists (__Secure-3PSID) are HttpOnly and are not in document.cookie.
youtube.pastePlaceholder: Paste cookies (must include SAPISID) or a cookies.txt export
youtube.partial: This session cannot open private playlists. Use the session from a browser:

account.title: Account
account.youtubeHint: YouTube — needed for age-restricted videos and your own playlists

hint.title: No playlists yet
hint.body: Follow a YouTube playlist or create a local one — both show up here.
hint.step1: In the search bar at the top, search a playlist by name or paste its link.
hint.step2: Open the Playlists tab in the results and tap the heart to follow it.
hint.step3: Or use the + button to create a local playlist.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyHint: Pick a playlist and click a track to start.

playlist.spotifyLoginNeeded: Sign in to Spotify to play these songs.

track.broken: This song is no longer available at its source.

youtubeId.title: YouTube audio
youtubeId.hintAssign: Paste the video ID or URL.
youtubeId.hintSearch: Search YouTube and pick the right video.
youtubeId.invalid: Paste a valid YouTube video ID or URL.
youtubeId.assignMode: Assign audio by ID or URL

following.empty: Nothing here yet. Follow a Spotify profile or a YouTube channel to see it in this list.

hint.title: Nothing to see yet
hint.body: Follow a Spotify profile or a YouTube channel and it will show up here.
hint.step1: In the search bar at the top, search an artist, profile or channel.
hint.step2: Open the profile or channel and tap the heart to follow it.
hint.step3: Spotify profiles and YouTube channels you follow appear on this page.

custom.empty: No playlists yet. Create one and add songs to it.
custom.noPlaylists: No playlists yet. Create one below.

hint.title: No local playlists yet
hint.body: Create a local playlist to collect songs that live on this device.
hint.step1: Tap the + button in the top corner of your playlists.
hint.step2: Name it and it appears in this list.
hint.step3: Open it and add songs from any source.

allHint.title: No playlists yet
allHint.body: Connect Spotify, follow a YouTube playlist, or create a local one — everything shows up here.
allHint.step1: In the search bar at the top, search a playlist by name or paste its link.
allHint.step2: Open the Playlists tab in the results and tap the heart to follow it.
allHint.step3: Or use the + button to create a local playlist.

rooms.empty: No saved rooms. Connect to a room and save it from the Rooms panel.

hint.title: No relay server yet
hint.body: Rooms are hosted by a relay, so you need one before you can join or host a room.
hint.step1: Open Settings and go to the Rooms section.
hint.step3: Come back here and join or host a room.

session.title: Rooms
session.relayRequiredBody: To use this feature you need a relay server. Configure one in Settings to start or join a room.
session.inRoom: You are in room {room}. Edit the code to switch rooms.
session.hostHint: If nobody is hosting it yet, you become the host; otherwise you join and listen in sync.
session.saveTitle: Save this room to the Rooms shelf
session.waiting: Waiting for the room to load…

relay.title: Rooms
relay.body: Relay server that syncs playback between devices. Rooms and their passwords are set from the Rooms panel.
relay.label: Relay server
relay.tokenRequired: This relay requires an auth token.
relay.pinned: Pinned by RELAY_API_URL, so changes are not saved.

errors.playbackBlocked: the browser needs a click to allow playback
errors.crash: Jota hit an unexpected error. Reload to keep going.

backend.loginUnavailable: In-app browser login is not available on this platform
backend.keyringLocked: The browser's cookies could not be read: unlock the keyring, close the browser and try again.
backend.installUnsupported: update: automatic install is not supported on this channel
backend.sessionPartial: YouTube did not accept this session, so private playlists, your own lists and liked songs cannot be opened. Sign in again from the browser, or import a cookies.txt exported while signed in.

relay.unreachable: Could not reach the relay. Check the address and your connection.
